caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This vertical bar chart, titled "Humour," illustrates numerical values across four distinct categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered alphanumerically from left to right as V1, V2, V3, and V4, without an overarching axis label. The vertical value axis utilizes a linear scale ranging from 60.0 to 80.0, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 2.5 alongside corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines, also without an explicit axis title. The chart displays four individual solid-colored bars, each featuring a numerical annotation directly above it specifying its exact value. From left to right, the blue bar for V1 indicates a value of 71.4, the orange bar for V2 indicates 68.5, the green bar for V3 represents the tallest bar in the chart with a value of 71.9, and the purple bar for V4 represents the shortest bar with a value of 68.15. The bars are not sorted by height, nor are they grouped or stacked, and the explicit numerical text above each bar serves to visually emphasize the exact data points.
